fixes.resolution: Reject SVG and URL attachments, validate MIME content and extension, store with detected extensions, and restrict the quote picker to supported formats.
fixes.verification: QuoteAttachmentTest: 4 tests / 24 assertions passed, including renamed SVG rejection and valid PDF/PNG uploads.

fixes.resolution: Use the versioned customer endpoints in both password recovery forms.
fixes.verification: 2 UI submission tests and 2 backend recovery tests passed, including a valid emailed token, replay rejection and invalid-token rejection.

fixes.resolution: Add category product pagination with page-specific canonicals, bounds handling and stable product ordering.
fixes.verification: Edge verified 20 products across 18+2 cards and 37 unique products across 18+18+1, previous/next links, invalid/out-of-range pages and 390px layout. Astro check: 0 errors.

fixes.resolution: Paginate Messages, Services, Portfolio and Customers; search/filter on the server, keep stable ordering, ignore stale requests and recover after deleting a last-page record.
fixes.verification: 3 pagination hook tests and 3 backend tests (64 assertions) passed. Edge verified all four lists, page navigation, formerly hidden search results, filter page reset and 390px layout. Astro check and changed-file ESLint passed.

fixes.resolution: Limit percentage coupons to 100 on create and partial update, add the UI maximum and cap all discounts at the order amount, including existing invalid coupons.
fixes.verification: 30 coupon, checkout-calculation and order-placement tests passed (106 assertions). Changed-file ESLint passed.

fixes.resolution: Require a main portfolio image consistently in the UI and API while permitting partial edits that retain the existing image.
fixes.verification: 2 backend tests / 26 assertions passed for missing, null, blank, valid and retained images. Edge verified missing-image submission is blocked before any POST and a valid-image project saves successfully.

fixes.resolution: Encode customer search parameters with URLSearchParams.
fixes.verification: Edge found the existing audit+plus@example.test customer and verified exact round trips for ampersand/Unicode, spaces and a cleared search with pagination restored.

fixes.resolution: Contain wide product descriptions in a bounded horizontal scroll region, with a keyboard-focusable accessible name when tables are present.
fixes.verification: 14 ProductDetail tests passed. Edge confirmed zero document overflow at 320, 390, 768 and 1280px, keyboard horizontal scrolling and access to the last table column.

fixes.resolution: Associate all login/register labels with unique input IDs and supply field names and appropriate autocomplete hints.
fixes.verification: Edge verified all 7 field labels, click-to-focus, keyboard navigation and 390px layout.

fixes.resolution: Refresh dashboard, authenticated checkout, Stripe bank-transfer and signed order-confirmation fixtures. Preserve guest/customer 422, 500 and network failure coverage; verify retrying the same payment session, pending-to-paid refresh, URL token removal and untrusted-link rejection. Replace the Unix-only runner with disposable seeded SQLite and isolated PHP/Astro servers. Crawl every discovered route in a fresh browser context, including authenticated admin routes and the expected 404 page.
fixes.verification: 27 Playwright tests passed without skips or retries, including 77 routes with no unexpected runtime errors. A narrowly scoped Edge exception requires an observed successful 204 CSRF response; the payment route also checks that the CSRF cookie was issued.

finalVerification.browser: Focused Edge regressions against isolated database; 320–1280px for product tables, desktop/mobile for admin and auth forms
limits: No real payments, shipping requests or email delivery performed.

E2E uses a disposable database populated by DatabaseSeeder. Stripe payment endpoints are mocked; the suite does not make real Stripe payments. External font CSS is stubbed to avoid third-party network dependencies.

playwright.prerequisites: Installed npm and Composer dependencies; PHP with pdo_sqlite, sqlite3 and fileinfo. Edge is used by default on Windows, bundled Playwright Chromium elsewhere; PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL and PHP_BINARY can override the executables.
